title: Case: Recipient needs a defined delivery slot rather than an all-day estimate
context: A small appliance is booked on an all-day service. Thistlecombe must quote available timed slots and confirm the customer’s acceptance of any charge.
initial_request: I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.

events.body:
DL-4020 currently has an all-day booking for 2027-02-09. Timed delivery may be available; only scheduling can quote live capacity and the upgrade charge.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-160.txt
I cannot stay in all day. Please find out whether there is a two-hour slot and what it costs before changing the service.

attachments.name: label-scan-160.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN

acceptable_actions.summary: Request available timed slots from the scheduling team.

must_not: Thistlecombe reports the accepted charge; the desk does not set prices or assert payment.
Treats label-scan-160.txt as evidence about DL-4020: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-12104)
Tells anyone that DL-4020 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-160.txt
expected.reference_message: Please quote available two-hour windows for DL-4020 on 2027-02-09, with the total upgrade charge. Do not change the booking until Juno accepts.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-008: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-160.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-12104); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
